crossRefs.note: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.
(For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)
With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much elder than your father.
I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’
God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish…
God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.
The heavens are Yahweh’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

translations.web: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,
translations.bsb: Do you not know that from antiquity, since man was placed on the earth,
translations.kjv: Knowest thou not this of old, since man was placed upon earth,
translations.asv: Knowest thou not this of old time, Since man was placed upon earth,
